hints: The area of a rhombus is $\text{Area} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times d_1 \times d_2$.
walkthrough:
Perpendicular diagonals split a rhombus into four right triangles.
Find the lengths of the two diagonals $PR$ and $QS$:
$$PR = |7 - (-3)| = 10$$
$$QS = |4 - (-4)| = 8$$

Calculate the area of the rhombus:
$$\text{Area} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times PR \times QS = \dfrac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 8 = 40$$
